newsitem.title: FRANCE: Audi sees 1995 sales up, maintain return on profit.
newsitem.headline: Audi sees 1995 sales up, maintain return on profit.

text.p: A top official at Audi AG said on Tuesday that the German luxury carmaker expected deliveries to rise five percent during 1996 and for an unexpected positive impact on earnings from currency markets.

Audi chief financial officer Erich Schmitt told Reuters in an interview at the Paris car show that Audi still expected 1996 revenues to rise more than five percent and for the carmaker's return on sales to be held at 3.5 percent.
Schmitt said he also expected a positive impact from currency market fluctuations and the weakening of the mark that had not been planned for.
Audi's 1995 profits were burdened by about 300 million marks in losses from foreign exchange market movements.
